findings.title: M-key mute chain broken: Key_Press{.M} is never translated to Intent Toggle_Mute — the entire mute path is dead
findings.location: app/input/mouse.odin:79-90 (phase-1 key collect), 116-123 (phase-1 intent switch), 314-341 (phase-2 switch); app/input/poll.odin:60
findings.detail: poll.odin emits Device_Event(Key_Press{.M}), types.odin declares Key.M + Toggle_Mute, exec.odin handles Toggle_Mute -> on_mute -> effect_mute/toggle_mute, but NEITHER mouse.odin phase (nor controller.odin/touch.odin) ever maps Key.M to the intent. Pressing M does nothing: acceptance 'M mutes through the intent layer' fails at runtime. Perkins verified: no 'case .M' exists anywhere in app/input/.
findings.recommended_fix: Add the mapping in mouse.odin phase-1 (collect .M like .T, then 'case .M: append(out, Intent(Toggle_Mute{}))'). mouse.odin is untouched by both #60 and #59 — collision-free.

findings.title: Single last-writer-wins caption slot: coincident alerts clobber each other — not every played alert is captioned
findings.detail: One Caption slot; set_caption overwrites unconditionally. flow_step emits arrivals BEFORE the crisis engine (core/step.odin:126,145), so a same-tick crisis caption wins; but on catch-up frames (multi-tick slices) a LATER-tick arrival clobbers an earlier crisis caption before it renders even one frame. 'Every audio alert captioned' is violated for any alert followed by another alert in the same consume batch.
findings.recommended_fix: Give crisis captions priority (don't let an arrival overwrite a live crisis caption), or queue captions. Minimal: in the arrival branch, skip set_caption when a crisis caption is still within dwell.

findings.title: u8 pending play counters accumulate unboundedly in the harness mirror (audio_flush never called) — wraps past 255
findings.detail: The harness feeds consumer_consume per tick but never flushes; pending.arrival_plays/crisis_plays (u8) accumulate and silently wrap past 255. Today's demo peaks at 227 (probe-verified), and nothing in the harness reads pending (the vacuous-guard reads draws: u64), so there is no behavioral impact — latent only.
findings.recommended_fix: Saturate instead of wrap (e.g. clamp at 255), make Pending counters u32, or call a no-device flush/clear in the harness loop.

findings.title: SYNTH_RAMP_S is declared but never referenced (the ramp uses the hardcoded SYNTH_RAMP_SAMPLES=110)
findings.detail: Unused constant; the derivation comment lives on SYNTH_RAMP_SAMPLES. Harmless doc-constant, but it is dead weight a reader must reconcile.
findings.recommended_fix: Delete SYNTH_RAMP_S or reference it in a compile-time assert tying SAMPLES to S*RATE.

findings.title: audio.dem header claims Packet_Arrived flows 'from tick ~16 on' but the first spawn is at 2000ms (tick 40) with the fixture off
findings.detail: Comment/recipe mismatch: with 'fixture off' there is no ambient flow, so the first arrival is tick 40 + travel time. Probe confirmed arrivals occur (227 plays) — the '~16' figure is simply wrong. Cosmetic doc inaccuracy in a blessed demo's contract header.
findings.recommended_fix: Correct the header (first arrivals at tick ~40+) or add the early flow it describes.

findings.title: Multiple Crisis_Triggered events in one consume batch collapse to N plays of the LAST-drawn variant (earlier draws discarded)
findings.detail: pending.crisis_variant is overwritten per event while crisis_plays counts all; audio_flush replays the last variant N times. Multi-crisis frames are rare (the golden run has exactly 1 crisis), so impact is cosmetic-variety only. Same shape for arrivals.
findings.recommended_fix: Stage per-play variants (small fixed array) or flush per event; at minimum document the collapse.

findings.title: Caption never expires on the Game_Over screen — app.tick freezes, so caption_live stays true indefinitely
findings.detail: draw_audio_caption runs in draw_hud for every mode including Game_Over; app.tick only advances while stepping, so an alert raised just before the terminal event keeps its caption (or the muted pill) on the game-over screen forever.
findings.recommended_fix: Skip the caption line when mode == .Game_Over, or expire captions on the terminal transition (audio_reset_run is only called on start_run).

findings.title: PR body claims ElevenLabs terms notes are 'carried in assets/audio/README.md' — the README carries none of them and names only Suno
findings.detail: The PR body relays same-day user rulings: SFX from ElevenLabs with three terms notes (perpetual commercial rights; default sublicensing opt-out toggle; Studio Games tier for music) and states they are carried in the README. The README instead instructs 'Generate in Suno (paid tier)' and contains none of the notes. The drop-in contract doc contradicts the PR body's fresh sourcing ruling.
findings.recommended_fix: Update assets/audio/README.md to the ElevenLabs sourcing + the three terms notes (or correct the PR body if Suno stands). One supplier story, written where the contract lives.

findings.title: Captions (text, 40-tick dwell, expiry, live-while-muted, mute pill) have no automated coverage
findings.detail: The a11y contract (hard requirement #3) is exercised by no test/golden: not the caption content, the dwell/expiry arithmetic, nor the live-while-muted behavior. The consumer half is device-free and unit-testable (the harness already runs it with a zero Audio). Demoted from the lens's blocker: the project's golden net covers sim/T2 pixels, HUD text has no coverage precedent — a rigor gap, not a merge blocker.
findings.recommended_fix: Add a harness assertion or core-style unit test on the pure consumer: caption text on crisis/arrival, dwell expiry at until_tick, caption set while muted.

findings.title: The golden cannot prove the crisis->sting draw: the vacuous-guard counts TOTAL draws, not per-kind
findings.detail: If the surge recipe rots (crisis stops firing), arrival draws alone keep draws>0 green and the crisis path silently drops out of the golden. Perkins probe (scratch copy, instrumented counters) verified today's run: draws=228, crisis_plays=1, arrival_plays=227 — so the golden is currently meaningful; the gap is future rot-resistance.
findings.recommended_fix: Assert per-kind minimums for the audio demo (e.g. crisis draws >= 1 and arrival draws >= 1), or track crisis draws separately in the guard.

findings.title: Arrival throttle (1 click / 2 ticks, e.tick-keyed, suppressed = silent+uncaptioned) is exercised but never asserted
findings.detail: The golden run passes arrival events through the throttle but nothing pins the suppression behavior: a regression to click-per-arrival (busy-tick buzz) would keep every gate green. The throttle is hard requirement #2's 'sane, documented throttle'.
findings.recommended_fix: Pin via the harness consumer: a dense-arrival demo asserting plays < arrivals, or a unit test on consumer_consume with scripted event ticks (0,1,2,3 -> plays at 0/2 only).

findings.title: Asset fallback + placeholder synth path untested: corrupt-file guard, wav_pack RIFF bytes, device-off silent fallback
findings.detail: No test covers: LoadSound on a 0-frame/corrupt file falling through to the placeholder (and the un-unloaded failed Sound), the WAV packer's header math, or the InitAudioDevice-fails path (captions live, flush inert). CI never exercises a device. P2-class gap.
findings.recommended_fix: Unit-test wav_pack header fields + a synth_wav length invariant; document the corrupt-file path as manually verified (or add a fixture file gate).

findings.title: Per-run freshness (audio_reset_run + audio_mark=0) has no coverage across restarts
findings.detail: Restart discipline (throttle position, stale caption, watermark) is reset in start_run but no test restarts a run and checks for leakage. Low risk — the reset is two assignments and ODN-13 freshness is reviewed.
findings.recommended_fix: Optional: a harness scenario with a scripted restart asserting the first-arrival click fires immediately (not throttle-inherited).

findings.title: Advisory test gate: CONCERNS
findings.detail: Re-derived by Perkins after verification: P0 (ODN-15 determinism neutrality) = 100% covered AND probe-proven (crisis_plays=1, 227 arrival draws, replay gate byte-identical, 9/9 native gates green). P1 gaps: the dead mute chain (tracked as the functional blocker), zero caption coverage, unasserted throttle + per-kind draws. The lens's mechanical FAIL was driven by treating view-layer caption coverage as gate-blocking; re-triaged to CONCERNS.
findings.recommended_fix: Clear the mute blocker; add the caption/throttle/per-kind assertions above to reach PASS.
